verdict.rationale: Runway's pricing docs describe a cheaper draft mode: `draft: true` on text, image or video to video bills at the 480p rate. That draft can then be enhanced to 1080p by referencing it with `draftTaskId`, which is exactly a draft-then-finalize-the-chosen-take workflow. The pricing page also lists 4K video upscaling. Missing for 10: draft enhancement via `draftTaskId` is documented only for text to video (not image or video to video), the docs snippet is thin with no detail on the upscale step's output quality, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a creator, I can draft fast in a cheaper mode and upscale the chosen take to final quality

citations.quote: A preview (`draft: true` on text to video, image to video, or video to video) bills at the 480p rate. Enhancing that preview to 1080p (`draftTaskId` on text to video)
